root_cause.text: In `papr_hvpipe_dev_create_handle()`, the `src_info` pointer is set to NULL by `retain_and_null_ptr(src_info)` to prevent automatic cleanup, but the function subsequently attempts to dereference this now-NULL pointer when adding it to the global `hvpipe_src_list`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "after call to retain_and_null_ptr(src_info), src_info is re-used for adding it to the global list", and the patch diff shows the removal of `retain_and_null_ptr(src_info)` prior to the `list_add(&src_info->list, &hvpipe_src_list)` call which caused the kernel panic.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a potential use-after-free bug by removing an incorrect duplicate source check that erroneously triggered automatic memory deallocation on an active source pointer.
intent_record.what: Removed the spinlock-protected lookup check for an existing source ID, deleted the associated error return path, removed the __free(kfree) auto-cleanup attribute from the src_info pointer, and declared a new local variable fd.
intent_record.how: It prevents a critical bug where finding an existing source would trigger an automatic and incorrect kfree of the active source structure when returning -EALREADY, while also removing the restriction on duplicate source allocation at this point in the flow.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix race conditions and resource leaks by registering the source before file descriptor creation and adding proper rollback cleanup on failure.
intent_record.what: Reordered the registration of the source ID and the creation of the file descriptor, replacing FD_PREPARE/fd_publish with FD_ADD, and added error handling/rollback logic (list deletion, message consumption, and memory freeing) if FD creation fails.
intent_record.how: Ensures that source exclusivity is verified and locked before allocating a file descriptor, preventing race conditions where multiple processes could attempt to acquire the same source, while guaranteeing proper resource cleanup on allocation failure.
